name.description: Lowercase; also the CLI command: malha <name> <command>.

main.description: The entry module, relative to the plugin folder.

exec.description: Programs it may run, e.g. "kubectl [--context *] get nodes -o json". * is one argument that is not a flag; [ ] is optional.

fetch.description: URLs it may request, e.g. "GET,POST https://api.example.com/v1/*". The host may be {options.<key>}, filled from malha.plugins.json: one origin, or a list of them.

files.description: Files outside its folder it may read, e.g. "~/.config/example/token".

topology.description: read: see the topology. propose: also suggest changes, which the user reviews as a diff.

analytics.description: Present if it exports analytics(ctx, request) (and optionally link(ctx, request)), called by malha analytics refresh and detect.

notify.description: Present if it exports notify(ctx, report), called by malha check --notify.

every.description: Seconds between refreshes while malha dev runs.
